cs.t: Currently some basic Philips for sports. They're nothing special but at least they don't fall off -- hurting my ear-skin a bit though. I had a pair of cordless Philips with Bluetooth, again for sports, which were very handy; sound quality wasn't excellent though, they were bulky and would fall off too easily, so eventually I lost them. My ideal headphones would be cordless, good for sports, noise-reducing, small and adjustable, fitting my ears without hurting.
cs.th: Ask HN: What headphones are you using?
